# Scans for the crop tests

Scans from Paris Musées (Musée Carnavalet), public domain (CC0), resized to 600 px on their
longest side. The file name is the Paris Musées id (`paris_musees:<id>`).

| File | Licence | What it tests |
|---|---|---|
| 765372.jpg | CC0 | a print whose sky is as pale as its card |
| 108561.jpg | CC0 | a card with a scanner rim and handwriting around it |
| 770571.jpg | CC0 | two cards, with printed labels above and below the print |
| 91949.jpg | CC0 | a stereoscopic pair with rounded, dark views |
| 112658.jpg | CC0 | one photo with a strong upright edge down its middle |
| 921318.jpg | CC0 | a pale sky and street, on no mount |
| 108438.jpg | CC0 | a thin dark rim and a pale sky, on no mount |
| 91790.jpg | CC0 | a stereoscopic pair whose views no straight line frames (full size, 1024 px) |

Credit: Paris Musées / Musée Carnavalet.
